### Why So Much Controversy over These Two Books?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-march-17-2021.html
Passage: Revelation 20:10
Points:
- Satan actively opposes Genesis and Revelation because they bookend Scripture and chronicle his origin and ultimate defeat.
- Genesis records the entrance of sin, the curse, and death, while Revelation reveals their complete and eternal removal.
- The judgment first pronounced against the serpent in Genesis is finally executed in Revelation 20:10 when he is cast into the lake of fire.
- What God set in motion at the original creation reaches perfect completion and victory in His new creation.

### Satan’s Final Assault
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/satans-final-assault
Passage: Revelation 20:7-10
Points:
- Before the final consummation of Christ’s kingdom, Scripture indicates that Satan will be released for one last surge of deception and hostility against the church.
- The vast rebel army gathered under the imagery of Gog and Magog forms a counterfeit assembly opposing God’s people.
- Though evil will mount a massive assault, God swiftly destroys the forces of darkness and casts the devil into judgment.
- Christians should not live in dread when evil intensifies, knowing that the Lord of hosts makes final defeat impossible for those in Christ.
